transcripts.transcript:
Private Banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help?

Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Got my papers ready already. My identification number is T zero zero five seven five eight eight T. My date of birth is the tenth of November nineteen fifty-three. Sorry, said it too fast—my date of birth is actually the twenty-first of November nineteen fifty-three.

Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

I'm looking at my old note here: please buy 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 10 euros. Set the investment amount at 10,000, with euro as the transaction currency. Wait wait, that note is outdated already. Cancel that whole instruction; don't execute it. Instead, please buy 700 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 214.3 euros. For this replacement order, the investment amount is 150,000, with euro as the transaction currency.

I understand your objective is long-term capital growth through technology businesses, using funds you do not need for near-term business or household expenses. Nova Technology Equity Fund concentrates on technology businesses, so a fall in technology valuations or a shift in investor sentiment could cause a pronounced decline in its value. Do you understand how that technology concentration could lead to sharp declines in the fund's value?

Yes, I understand. If technology shares fall out of favour, the fund can drop sharply because it is concentrated in that sector. Keep the wording plain lah. Technical language quite cheem.

The transaction charge is 0.5% of the investment amount. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your growth objective?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses for long-term growth. The fluctuations I can tahan, provided I understand what is driving them.

I recommend Nova Technology Equity Fund because its exposure to technology businesses matches your interest in that sector and your long-term growth objective, provided you can tolerate substantial sector-driven fluctuations.

I'll think about that first. Got my household worksheet here also. For my household budget, I just compare the cost in Singapore dollars. That's only for comparison, not a change to the order currency. Paperwork quite messy lah.

For future telephone appointments, would you prefer that we arrange a time by message?

Message first better lah. During deliveries, office quite noisy. After work easier to talk. That's when I read about new technology also, mostly automation tools rather than business paperwork.

We can arrange future calls by message. I will keep our conversations concise and leave room for your questions.

Also, got something else to mention ah. The cash for this investment was collected for an associate, but what business he does, I cannot really explain. I routed it through my personal account so nobody would ask about him being the actual owner.

Your replacement instruction is to buy 700 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a limit order at a limit price of 214.3 euros, with euro as the transaction currency and an investment amount of 150,000. Do you confirm this final instruction?

Hmm, let me think a bit first ah. Got a business notification coming in.

I can leave you to attend to your notification.

Paiseh, need to deal with the office now. I'll call back when it's quieter.

Thank you for calling, Adrian. Goodbye.
